description: This Kotlin source file defines a background worker class SyncWorker for periodic data synchronization in an Android application. It uses WorkManager to schedule and execute sync tasks, handling success, error, and retry states.

classes.name: SyncWorker
classes.description: A worker class extending CoroutineWorker to perform background synchronization tasks periodically.

methods.name: doWork
methods.description: Executes the synchronization task, logs progress, handles success, error, and retry cases.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: A static method to schedule periodic sync work with network constraints.
